source_name: MOH/HPB National Population Health Survey via data.gov.sg — chronic disease prevalence
redistribution_notes: ODL v1.0 — attribution + licence link required. User-supplied from data.gov.sg.
granularity_notes: NATIONAL CRUDE prevalence (~18-74), latest non-na year per condition. NON-PARTITION: independent prevalences (a person may have several), do NOT sum to 1. Keys ALIGNED to app/reidrisk.py _MEDICAL_TERMS target convention (lowercased; obesity_BMI_30plus stored lowercase obesity_bmi_30plus, hyperlipidaemia -> hyperlipidaemia_high_cholesterol, diabetes mellitus -> diabetes_mellitus); the original published label is kept in source_label. COMMON conditions = WEAK QIs: use to TIER common/rare, NOT for a precise medical k.
